title: A Cover for the Protocol
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
